verdict.rationale: OCI documents REST APIs, a CLI that provides "the same core functionality as the Console, plus additional commands," SDKs for building apps, and Terraform provider for infrastructure-as-code — covering the major automation-parity claim for an AI-native/API-driven user. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that every single Console feature has an API/CLI equivalent (no explicit gap analysis) and no discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec at the probed endpoints.
